title: E-IPFS
tagline: E-IPFS (Enterprise IPFS) is an IPFS cloud service for enterprises.
description:
E-IPFS is a hybrid IPFS service that embraces the advantages of decentralization and access security.
It has the advantage of implementing decentralization based on IPFS/Filecoin and securing transmission security through OpenVPN.
Through OpenVPN and VPN Tunneling, it is possible to record access users and access histories and control the transmission security of important data.
how_its_made:
A key detail of this project is its attempt to fill in the gaps in IPFS to become a service that businesses can use.
Decentralization and security were considered together using IPFS and OpenVPN technology.
By applying Ceramic's Self.id, we even considered the protection of personal information and made several attempts.
In the future, we believe it has the potential to evolve into an IPFS file sharing service that can be used for corporate collaboration like Slack or Notion.
